subject.title: feat(events): add structured ClawSweeper session events

question: Should Crabfleet adopt this structured session-event schema and five-minute terminal append window as a durable public API and archive contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but choosing the permanent stored schema, additive event representation, and post-terminal authorization policy requires maintainer ownership rather than automated repair judgment.

options.title: Approve the bounded contract
options.body: Accept the additive schema, legacy null/message/null mapping, five-minute terminal retry window, and documented ledger limits, with hosted checks or maintainer-selected staging proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Keep the PR open while revising the public fields, terminal authorization window, or persistence shape before those choices become durable.

options.title: Do not add persistent events
options.body: Close the direction if ClawSweeper telemetry should remain outside Crabfleet's session database and archive API.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded contract
recommendation.body: Accept the additive schema, legacy null/message/null mapping, five-minute terminal retry window, and documented ledger limits, with hosted checks or maintainer-selected staging proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history makes this the strongest owner for the existing session-event, migration, and archive compatibility surface.
